_doc: Template roster for linear-autopilot. `bin/harness init` copies it to $AUTOPILOT_CONFIG_DIR/models.json (never edited in the repo); `/autopilot-init` then records the subscriptions the owner names and runs `bin/harness check`. Tier policy (README, Tiers): every entry has `level` (0-4), `vendor` and `subscription`; a role takes every model of its tier (`roles`), drawn at run time at random weighted by the credit left on its account (no hand-ordered pools). Vendor -> CLI is fixed: anthropic=claude, openai=codex, google=agy, mistral=vibe, xai=grok|cursor, any other vendor=opencode. Mistral, free models and old Gemini are Tier 4 whatever `level` says. `family` (with a `*` for the version) drives `run-model discover`: the newest id of the family replaces the entry after a smoke test, its level following `tier_table`. Model ids below are examples from November 2026.
codex_auto_reset_doc: Owner's standing authorization (2026-11-09): run-model redeems a Codex usage reset by itself (bin/codex-reset --yes) when a fresh reading shows an account's WEEKLY window at 100%, once per account per weekly window, then smoke-tests the account. false = never; the outage is then a CRITICAL alert.
review_wait_minutes_doc: bin/review waits for an eligible reviewer that comes back within this window when none is eligible now (a ticket code review first falls back to Tier 1, logged); beyond it, a CRITICAL alert, never Tier 0 or 4.
escalate_after_round_doc: Owner's rule (2026-11-09): per ticket at most one implementation and two fixes by a Tier 3 model. An implement or fix run whose round (`run-model run implement --round N`, else the name `<ISSUE>-impl-<n>.md`) is above this number runs as `--escalate` (Tier 2, never Tier 1, logged in state.json `escalations`); `--no-escalate` keeps Tier 3 for a mechanical merge-only round.
coordinator_reserve_doc: percent of each window that must stay left on the coordinator's own account (detected per session) before any model runs on it: the coordinator must never run out of credits. Below it: refused, CRITICAL alert.
roles_doc: role -> levels. Bounded by the policy in code: implement/fix Tier 3, review Tier 2 (Tier 1 as bin/review's logged backup when no Tier 2 reviewer is eligible), plan_review/premortem/milestone_review/coordinate Tier 1, trivial Tier 4 (or 3); `--escalate` (automatic past `escalate_after_round`) = one level above implement, never Tier 1; Tier 0 never automatic.
subscription_doc: per entry, set by /autopilot-init after asking the owner (never a default): paid (a plan the owner pays for), paid? (paid, plan not confirmed), free (free plan, low limits), reserved (kept for other uses: never selected; `bin/harness subscription <cli> <account> reserved --reason ...`). `excluded: <reason>` removes one entry; a project's state.json `exclude` removes keys or whole accounts for that project only. Draw weights: paid 1, paid? or unset 0.7, free 0.25, times the credit left on the account. The coordinator's own account is not configured here: it is detected per session (adapter `coordinator_env`, `bin/run-model whoami`) and protected (last resort, cheap roles, `coordinator_reserve`).
tier_table_doc: owner overrides of the built-in tier table (bin/autopilot_lib.py DEFAULT_TIER_TABLE, Nov 2026), first match wins: [{"match": "<regex on the model id>", "level": n}]

agy-gemini-flash.note: Google Antigravity (agy): the only CLI for Google models

vibe-mistral.note: Mistral Vibe: Tier 4 like every Mistral model (trivial tasks only)
